top_creatures.label: Slow wall beast
top_creatures.why: Heavy body with three mouth guns and a blood leak; reads as a wall at 375 px.
top_creatures.keep: Never disabled, so it must be destroyed; slow mass.
top_creatures.change: Name; mouth guns become crystal crest spines; blood colour and death sequence are ours.

top_creatures.label: Growth pair
top_creatures.why: Juvenile hull 2800 against adult 9600, so growth is obvious at a glance.
top_creatures.keep: Juvenile-to-adult silhouette jump; looping idle frames.
top_creatures.change: Body shape and the growth trigger (tied to zone time, not a fixed value).

top_creatures.label: Cloaked guardian
top_creatures.why: Largest creature; a dim cloak is a readable tell and it hides near smaller ones.
top_creatures.keep: Cloak as a tell with a shield-heavy body.
top_creatures.change: Reveal on hit instead of on a timer; shape and colour.

top_creatures.label: Death-burst swarm member
top_creatures.why: Docile swarm where one member bursts on death, a surprise for the attacker.
top_creatures.change: Crystal shards instead of solar bodies; burst radius set by our rules.

top_creatures.label: Spinning defender
top_creatures.why: Constant rotation as a defence against small hits; clear silhouette.
top_creatures.change: Spin speed and what it blocks.

top_creatures.label: Head-count ladder
top_creatures.why: Tier steps add guns and turrets; Hydra has three culverin guns, two stratospear turrets and one ribault turret.
top_creatures.keep: Light, medium, heavy ladder in one family look.

top_creatures.label: Self-heating attacker
top_creatures.why: Hurts itself when it runs hot, so a long fight has a cost on both sides.
top_creatures.keep: Overheat damage with hysteresis: on at max heat, off below 90 percent (source/Ship.cpp:5068-5072).
top_creatures.change: Our own heat meter and the glow tell.

top_creatures.label: Rare long-hauler
top_creatures.why: Rare, large body that travels where small ships cannot; rarity is the signal.
top_creatures.keep: Rarity and size as the signal.

looks.label: One spark per status channel
looks.technique: Each status (ion, scramble, disruption, discharge, slowing, corrosion, burning, leakage) has its own sprite, frame rate, lifetime, spin and drift; corrosion lives 60 ticks and drifts backwards.

looks.label: Shape-coded target rings
looks.technique: Outer ring (shields) is solid; inner (hull) and disabled rings are dashed; colour is set by relation and ring type. Shape carries the channel so it reads without colour.

looks.label: Numbered frame strips
looks.technique: Hit sparks as ^0 to ^4 frames and thruster glow as +0 to +2 frames, so effects are cheap to swap.

looks.label: Looping idle creatures
looks.technique: The rewind flag loops idle sprites for creatures that never stop moving.

looks.label: Fast-flung remnant sparkle
looks.technique: Short-lived (lifetime 7) with random velocity 12, a burst of debris.

originals.name: Mythic-tier beast ladder
originals.idea: One creature family with light, medium and heavy hulls that add guns per tier.
originals.keep: Tier ladder inside one family look; more guns per tier.
originals.change: Our names, silhouettes and tier steps. Rows 7.

originals.name: Never-disabled brute
originals.idea: A slow, heavy creature that cannot be disabled, only destroyed or staggered by a finisher.
originals.change: A stagger stance broken by a finisher, not a disable threshold. Rows 9 and 3.

originals.name: Explode-on-death swarm
originals.idea: A docile swarm where one member bursts on death.
originals.change: Crystal shards and our own burst radius. Rows 8 and 10.

originals.name: Juvenile-to-adult pair
originals.idea: A creature that grows visibly from a juvenile silhouette.
originals.keep: Silhouette jump and looping idle frames.
originals.change: Growth trigger tied to zone time. Rows 7 and 23.

originals.name: Overheat self-harm
originals.idea: A creature takes hull damage when it runs too hot.
originals.keep: Hysteresis: on at max heat, off below 90 percent.
originals.change: Our own heat meter and clear glow tell. Rows 2 and 4.

originals.name: Reinforcement cap by strength ratio
originals.idea: No reinforcement when allies outnumber enemies by more than twice.
originals.change: Map to MAX_ATTACKERS = 3 and zone population. Rows 4 and 23.

originals.name: Timed weather with rolled strength
originals.idea: A hazard rolls its duration and strength when it triggers.
originals.keep: Rolled duration (1 to 200 for heat) and strength (data/hazards.txt:15).
originals.change: A readable warning colour and our biome. Rows 14 and 16.
